configuration_review: All 12 requests completed normally at 32768 context. Full-source prompt 13773 tokens, output 633 tokens; omissions are generated-content omissions, not input truncation or a token-cap stop.
citation_review: Fifteen stated answers have supported page sets, with the remaining false-absence answer contradicting its cited source. Infanticide in the H2 summary/synthesis wrongly cites illustration 172. H4 territorial gains require 361–362 rather than 360–361. Other principal events and dates match their supplied page ranges. Fourteen stated answers have marked quotations, including brief word/phrase excerpts; quotation-format counts alone do not establish comprehensive quoted evidence.
supported_content_review: Direct and merged summaries usually attribute author evaluations, preserve practically disappeared paganism and by 1421, and keep source JohnVI,1439 conversion, and limited money plus 300 mercenaries. Full control correctly retains almost exterminated Alans, indecisive Ad Salices and 40,000Roman deaths.

No new clear material historical error family was identified in synthesis or the independent full control.
